text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementAstronomyHow Future Lunar Colonists Can Farm Potatoes on the MoonA new study discovered a recipe for successJCBy Jake Currie3:00 PM CST on November 19, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleIn the movie The Martian, Matt Damon’s character (botanist Mark Watney) finds himself stranded on Mars. With any rescue months away and food supplies dwindling, he decides to do what he does best—grow some plants. Watley mixes the Martian soil with fertilizer provided by the crew’s waste and plants potatoes. Powered By 10 ShareNextStayIt’s a good plan (spoiler alert: it worked). Potatoes are both nutritionally dense and provide a high number of calories per unit of land (they’re also versatile and delicious). According to a new study published in npj Microgravity, they may even be able to feed future lunar colonists.Read more: “How Potatoes Shaped the Genes of the First People to Grow Them”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
